prompts.name: bellwether
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated transparent RGBA game organism sprite for MICROVERSE, a premium meditative microscopy game. Reference image is material/style reference ONLY: match its astonishing intricate translucent wet cytoplasm, crisp phase-contrast silvery edges, microgranules, fibrous organelles, organic photoreal microscopy quality. Create a DIFFERENT species. Centered entire organism with ample empty transparent margin, square canvas, orthographic top view, one main luminous nucleus exactly at image center (50%,50%) for gameplay registration. No environment, floor, shadow, text, glow cloud, frame, watermark, or other organisms. Genuine transparent background. Subject: Bellwether predator. A delicate radial bell-shaped rotifer seen from above, scalloped circular clear membrane, many gracefully curved short feeding filaments arranged in a crown, amber-peach central nucleus, radial threads and small opalescent digestive vacuoles. Broad rounded upper bell with tiny contracted forked tail below. Distinct from the reference's long oval. Keep nucleus perfectly centered. Elegant glass and gold, not cartoon or jellyfish fantasy.
